## Incident Overview

**Component:** tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_schema_compliance_pr80.py
**Condition:** Integration test runs runner.py against PR-80 diff fixture with real Anthropic API calls
**Observed Result:** Test fails non-deterministically — observed two distinct failure modes across consecutive runs: (1) schema correction exhausted 1 attempt, (2) 6 critical + 21 important blocking findings

**code_version:** 667ba6983df3728ad9111ac93ae77fd174e29340

## Evidence

Run bfpke75d2 (local): schema correction exhausted all 1 attempt(s) — synthetic schema_error present
Run bmdnfm3be (local): llm-review found blocking finding(s) — 6 critical, 21 important

CI Python Skill/Doc Tests passes consistently because CI runs pytest with -m 'not integration', skipping this test.

## Root Cause

The test asserts runner.py exits 0 (no blocking findings) when reviewing the PR-80 diff fixture. Real LLM calls produce variable findings across runs, so exit code varies. The test is checking schema compliance durability (story 0ba6-2bc9-74b6-44aa) but the returncode assertion is fragile against LLM variance.

## Expected Behavior

Test should either (a) mock LLM calls to produce deterministic output, or (b) only assert schema compliance of findings (not zero blocking findings).
data.title: test_schema_compliance_pr80: integration test flaky — real API calls produce varying findings, causing test failure (schema errors vs. blocking findings across runs)
